stem: Telomerase is an enzyme that is important in maintaining the telomeres that are located at the ends of chromosomes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Suggest why telomerase is present in much higher quantities in stem cells and cancer cells than in other cell types.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Studies suggest that telomerase is a flexible molecule when binding its substrate. The active site changes its shape slightly to allow the formation of the enzyme-substrate complex.

Name the theory that describes this mode of enzyme action.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
An investigation was carried out into the effect of substrate concentration on the activity of telomerase.

The results are shown in Fig. 6.1.

{{figure:figure_6_1.png}}

With reference to Fig. 6.1, explain the difference in the rates of reaction obtained for telomerase at a substrate concentration of $0.2 \mu\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ compared with a substrate concentration of $1.6 \mu\text{mol dm}^{-3}$.
